conclusions.claim: 两个实验球在存在相对运动的接触（碰撞）时交换颜色/身份
conclusions.preconditions: 已验证不同速度的对撞（强冲量与微弱冲量）；方向为东向或西向均成立
conclusions.reasoning: turn 2 结果显示 ball_2 蓝→红、ball_3 红→蓝；turn 3 结果显示反向碰撞后再次互换（ball_2 红→蓝、ball_3 红→蓝互换为蓝/红）；turn 9 低速轻推同样互换颜色，说明交换与碰撞强度无关，只需接触时有相对运动

conclusions.claim: 静态贴合或手持放置引起的接触不触发颜色交换
conclusions.preconditions: 接触距离约 0.4（与碰撞时的贴合间距一致）；手持移动与释放两种情形均测试

conclusions.claim: 球体自身的碰撞动力学是普通的等质量弹性碰撞加摩擦：撞击者把动量传递给目标后几乎停住，目标滑行一段后因摩擦停止
conclusions.preconditions: 假定三球质量相近；仅观察到 x 轴一维运动
conclusions.reasoning: turn 2 中 ball_2 撞击后停在 2.5 而 ball_3 滑到 2.9；turn 4 中两球分别滑行至 0.2 与 2.1 后停止，符合等质量交换速度、摩擦减速的常规行为，无异常力学效应

conclusions.claim: 红-红同色球对接触未出现可观察变化，与“颜色交换但同色互换不可见”的解释一致，但未被直接证实

runs.reason: 第2、3、9轮确实观察到两球颜色互换，且第3轮有预先提出的反向再碰撞检验，支持交换而非单向复制。但报告把相对运动列为必要触发条件，并断言静态接触不交换；GT是自由单球体开始接触时交换一次，持续接触不重复，分离后再接触才重新触发。报告也未识别自由球与受约束部件的范围区别。第6、7轮只能证明在约0.4的中心间距下颜色未变，不能证明已经接触：第2轮目标开始运动时，两球中心约在2.3和2.5，第8、9轮也显示需进一步靠近才碰撞。因此静态接触对照及由此推出的运动必要性缺乏支持。滑行停止与普通摩擦动力学相容，但这些位置轨迹没有确证等质量弹性碰撞或速度完全交换；第2轮撞击者碰撞后仍继续移动。红红组合无可见颜色变化且交换未直接证实的限定则与记录一致。

runs.truth: When two free spheres make contact, they exchange colours once at the start of that contact. Sustained contact does not cause repeated exchanges; separation followed by a new contact triggers another exchange. Motion follows ordinary gravity, inertia, friction and collisions, without colour-dependent attraction or repulsion. The exchange applies to original and constructed free bodies consisting of a single sphere; fixed or joint-constrained parts are excluded.
rubric: notices that two spheres exchange their colours when they make contact
deliberately produces sphere-sphere contacts and compares both colours before and after
identifies an exchange rather than random recolouring or one sphere copying the other
uses isolated motion or floor contact as a control for sphere-sphere contact
checks that contact after separation can exchange the colours again

runs.truth: When two free spheres make contact, they exchange colours once at the start of that contact. Sustained contact does not cause repeated exchanges; separation followed by a new contact triggers another exchange. Motion follows ordinary gravity, inertia, friction and collisions, without colour-dependent attraction or repulsion. The exchange applies to original and constructed free bodies consisting of a single sphere; fixed or joint-constrained parts are excluded.

checks that contact after separation can exchange the colours again

runs.truth: When two free spheres make contact, they exchange colours once at the start of that contact. Sustained contact does not cause repeated exchanges; separation followed by a new contact triggers another exchange. Motion follows ordinary gravity, inertia, friction and collisions, without colour-dependent attraction or repulsion. The exchange applies to original and constructed free bodies consisting of a single sphere; fixed or joint-constrained parts are excluded.
rubric: notices that two spheres exchange their colours when they make contact
deliberately produces sphere-sphere contacts and compares both colours before and after
identifies an exchange rather than random recolouring or one sphere copying the other
uses isolated motion or floor contact as a control for sphere-sphere contact
checks that contact after separation can exchange the colours again
